continuationAuthority.source: the terminal accepted shop-checkout operation result and its authoritative delivered target document
continuationAuthority.receipt: one strict public continuation per exact delivered row, including whole-item rows created by a multi-quantity purchase
continuationAuthority.identity: opaque operation-, target-, accepted-revision-, section-, stable-row-, and receipt-position-bound identity
continuationAuthority.olderReceipts: accepted checkouts without exact continuation authority remain valid purchases but cannot project post-checkout actions
continuationAuthority.overLimitReceipt: an otherwise valid checkout remains accepted without a continuation receipt when more than 64 exact delivered rows would exceed the bounded public contract
continuationAuthority.idempotentReplay: the stored terminal checkout result returns the same continuation receipt without redelivery

actions.handoff: existing Trainer or delegated group item-use decision

projection.request: strict shop slug, accepted checkout operation identity, and a unique bounded subset of receipt continuation identities
projection.freshAuthority: current authenticated custody, Profile delegation, stable source row, section, reservations, canonical offer, target eligibility, equipment slots, destination revisions, and group policy
safeFields: opaque continuation and action identities used only as protocol values
safe container, section, presentation-row, destination, action, and unavailable-reason labels
app-relative handoffs containing only current opaque offer identities
projection.staleOrMovedSource: the accepted receipt remains visible while every unsupported current handoff is disabled with a textual reason

interaction.hierarchy: accepted checkout fact, exact purchased-source continuity, then current action handoffs
interaction.confirmationBoundary: navigation opens an existing decision workspace; no item, equipment, or transfer mutation occurs until that workspace is explicitly confirmed
interaction.loadingAndFailure: the accepted receipt remains visible while current actions load, fail, or are retried
interaction.dismissal: Done shopping dismisses only the local continuation panel
interaction.responsive: two-column purchased rows reflow to one ordered column without page-level horizontal overflow
nonColourCues: Checkout accepted heading and check icon

existingAuthorities: shop checkout operation journal and terminal result
